messages:
Jules (Comms): Heads-up: all-hands in 15. Quick check list: stream health, slides, mic levels, and Q&A handoff.
Ravi (Infra): Encoder health is green. I patched a weird 502 yesterday but restarted the service; we should be OK.
Tess (AV): Mic C is acting up (low gain). I brought a backup handheld that reads fine. If we swap, audio will be flatter.
Jules (Comms): Can someone confirm which slide deck we use? Leadership wants to trim to one page of bullets.
Marin (Product): I uploaded "AH_roadmap_trim.pdf" to drive and linked it in the agenda thread. Use pages 1-2 only.
Jules (Comms): Perfect. Also, should Carlos do the first 3 mins then open to live Q&A?
Carlos (CEO): Yes short intro then 10min Q&A. Marin, have 2 backup answers ready for infra and pricing.
Marin (Product): Will do: infra: autoscale batch improvements; pricing: new burst credits pilot.
Tess (AV): Doing a quick soundcheck now. If we swap to handheld, note: you'll need to speak close to mic to avoid room noise.
Ravi (Infra): If the stream drops, quick fix: ```ssh stream-host && sudo systemctl restart stream.service``` — that restores within 12s. Also I pushed a small config to reduce reconnect flapping.
stream-bot: Reminder: recording scheduled in 10 minutes. Channel: #all-hands.
Jules (Comms): Tess, can you set a 1s delay on the monitor to avoid echo? Last time we had bleed into the mic.
Tess (AV): On it. Setting monitor delay to 1s and enabling low-latency mode.
Ravi (Infra): ETA for on-site backup server if needed ~7m. I brought a laptop build to bridge if the encoder fails.
Carlos (CEO): Also call out the Dedicated throughput numbers in the intro (500 tok/s median, improved caching). Keep it short.
Marin (Product): Noted. Two bullets only, no deep dive.
Jules (Comms): Ok action list: (1) Tess swap to handheld if issues, (2) Ravi keep restart command ready, (3) Marin and Carlos rehearse 3-min intro. React with :white_check_mark: when ready.
Tess (AV): :white_check_mark: swapping mic now
Ravi (Infra): :white_check_mark: ready with command
Marin (Product): :white_check_mark: 2-min dry run in 5
stream-bot: Recording started at 1968001360
Jules (Comms): Great, see you all in the room.
